capabilities: Publish a note or folder to SmartKeep with public or password-protected access
Sync vault files and attachments with OneDrive on Windows and Android
Review, apply and undo AI-suggested edits to a note or selection
Sync a Windows vault with a chosen external folder
Configure an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and model for AI editing
disambiguation: Not a Markdown formatter or linter despite the name; it publishes notes, syncs files and reviews AI edits.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.15.1 or later. Interface is English by default with a Simplified Chinese option saved per device. AI features are optional and may incur provider charges; requests over HTTP are sent unencrypted, so HTTPS is advised for remote services.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to SmartKeep, keep a vault in step through OneDrive, or preview AI rewrites before they touch a note.

relations.evidence: OneDrive sync (Windows and Android). Sign in to a Microsoft account on each device.
Sign in from SmartMD, then select the note or folder to publish.

summary: Plugin that publishes notes to SmartKeep, syncs vault files with OneDrive on Windows and Android, and applies reviewed AI edits.
